_about: Deterministic ROLE GATE (src/roleGate.ts). Runs on the job TITLE before the matcher and again inside gates.apply_vetoes. Order: deny words (win over everything) -> pay-model phrases in the posting -> allowed families -> borderline families -> anything else is rejected. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions on the title. Owner level: no level is declared in user-data or config (the resume only shows job titles), so every seniority word is allowed and the matcher judges level fit in seniority_comp.

borderline.note: React Native is mobile; allowed to the matcher only with the strict flag. A title that is also full-stack/frontend is allowed outright.
Backend or Node roles go to the matcher (strict) only when the title or the posting shows a full-stack, javascript, typescript, node or react signal; otherwise rejected.
A bare Developer or Engineer title says nothing about the stack; the matcher is told to be strict.
